evidence: Changes FinalizePSBT in src/psbt.cpp directly altering the correctness of data returned by the finalizepsbt RPC.
rationale: FinalizePSBT falsely reported complete: true and returned raw transaction hexes that fail mempool verification when inputs contained invalid final script fields. The PR description shows that flipping a bit in the final witness allows invalid transactions through finalizepsbt while analyzepsbt correctly rejects them, fixing a correctness flaw in returned RPC data and bringing FinalizePSBT in line with prior fixes #30357 and #33014.
